SELECT * FROM EDS.DATE_dIM


CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1587' AND MMYYYY='021984' will be updated on the next run. 
CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='082051' will be deleted from the source on the next run .
CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1302' AND MMYYYY='021984' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed.
CAL_B2K_TYPE='9999' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='999' AND MMYYYY='999999' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table).
UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE] SET DEL_FLG='D' 
WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1587' AND MMYYYY='021984' AND H = 'D';

DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE] 
WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='021984' AND H = 'D';


UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20231027','20231030');
